cases.sentence: Я открылся тем, кто не спрашивал Меня. Народу, не призывавшему Мое _____, Я сказал, «Я здесь».
cases.translation: I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me. To a nation that did not call on my name, I said, 'Here I am.'
cases.explain: The verb 'призывавшему' (called upon) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Весь день я простирал руки мои к _________ упрямому, что ходит путями недобрыми.
cases.translation: All day I have spread out my hands to a rebellious people who walk in ways that are not good.
cases.explain: The preposition 'к' (to) always requires the dative case.

cases.sentence: Ходит путями недобрыми, по собственным умыслам, к народу, что постоянно оскорбляет меня, приносят жертвы в садах и возжигают благовония на кирпичных _____________.
cases.translation: They walk in ways that are not good, according to their own thoughts, to the people who provoke me, sacrificing in gardens and burning incense on brick altars.
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on) when indicating location requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Приносят жертвы в _________ и возжигают благовония на кирпичных жертвенниках.
cases.translation: They sacrifice in gardens and burn incense on brick altars.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) when indicating location requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Они будут строить дома и жить в них, сажать __________ и есть их плоды.
cases.translation: They will build houses and live in them; they will plant vineyards and eat their fruit.
cases.explain: The verb 'сажать' (to plant) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Не будут ни вредить, ни разрушать на всей святой _______ моей, говорит Господь.
cases.translation: They will not hurt or destroy on all my holy mountain.
cases.explain: The preposition 'на' (on) when indicating location requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Вот я творю новое _______ и новую землю.
cases.translation: Behold, I create new heavens and a new earth.
cases.explain: The verb 'творю' (I create) is transitive and requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Волк и агнец будут кормиться вместе, и лев, как вол, будет есть сено, а для _______ пыль будет пищей.
cases.translation: The wolf and the lamb will feed together, and the lion will eat straw like the ox, and dust will be the serpent's food.
cases.explain: The preposition 'для' (for) always requires the genitive case.

reading.ru: Я открылся тем, кто не спрашивал Меня. Я найден теми, кто не искал Меня.
reading.question: According to this verse, who does God reveal himself to?
options: Those who ask for him and those who seek him
Those who do not ask for him and those who do not seek him
Only the righteous who pray daily
Only the priests in the temple
reading.correct: Those who do not ask for him and those who do not seek him
reading.explain: The text states 'Я открылся тем, кто не спрашивал Меня. Я найден теми, кто не искал Меня' — I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me, I was found by those who did not seek me.

reading.ru: Весь день я простирал руки мои к народу упрямому, что ходит путями недобрыми, по собственным умыслам.
reading.question: What does God do all day, and how is the people described?
options: He stretches out his hands to a rebellious people who walk in bad ways and follow their own thoughts
He hides from a obedient people who follow the law
He blesses a faithful people who walk in righteousness
He judges a wealthy people who forget his name
reading.correct: He stretches out his hands to a rebellious people who walk in bad ways and follow their own thoughts
reading.explain: God says 'Весь день я простирал руки мои к народу упрямому, что ходит путями недобрыми' — all day I stretched out my hands to a rebellious people who walk in ways that are not good.

reading.ru: Они будут строить дома и жить в них, сажать виноградники и есть их плоды.
reading.question: What will God's servants do in the new creation?
options: Build houses to live in and plant vineyards to enjoy their fruit
Be homeless and wander through the desert
Serve others and receive no reward
reading.correct: Build houses to live in and plant vineyards to enjoy their fruit
reading.explain: The passage says 'Они будут строить дома и жить в них, сажать виноградники и есть их плоды' — they will build houses and live in them, plant vineyards and eat their fruit.

reading.ru: Вот я творю новое небо и новую землю. Не прибудет в памяти прежнее и на ум не придет.
reading.question: What will God create, and what will be forgotten?
options: New heavens and new earth; the former things will be forgotten and not come to mind
A new temple; all old buildings will be destroyed
New laws; the old commandments will be broken
A new king; former rulers will be condemned
reading.correct: New heavens and new earth; the former things will be forgotten and not come to mind
reading.explain: The text says 'Вот я творю новое небо и новую землю. Не прибудет в памяти прежнее' — I create new heavens and new earth; the former things will not be remembered.

reading.ru: Слуги мои будут есть, а вы будете голодать. Слуги мои будут пить, а вы будете жаждать. Слуги мои будут радоваться, а вы будете постыжены.
reading.question: What is the contrast God describes between his servants and those who forsake him?
options: His servants will eat while others hunger; his servants will drink while others thirst; his servants will rejoice while others are ashamed
All people will be equal in blessing
The forsaken will be blessed while servants suffer
God will forget both groups equally
reading.correct: His servants will eat while others hunger; his servants will drink while others thirst; his servants will rejoice while others are ashamed
reading.explain: The passage contrasts: 'Слуги мои будут есть, а вы будете голодать' and 'Слуги мои будут пить, а вы будете жаждать' — my servants will eat while you hunger, my servants will drink while you thirst.

reading.ru: Волк и агнец будут кормиться вместе, и лев, как вол, будет есть сено, а для змеи пыль будет пищей.
reading.question: What will be the relationship between different animals in God's holy mountain?
options: Wolf and lamb will feed together, the lion will eat grass like an ox, and dust will be the serpent's food
Predators will hunt weaker animals as before
All animals will disappear from the earth
reading.correct: Wolf and lamb will feed together, the lion will eat grass like an ox, and dust will be the serpent's food
reading.explain: The text describes 'Волк и агнец будут кормиться вместе, и лев, как вол, будет есть сено' — the wolf and lamb will feed together, the lion will eat straw like the ox.
